# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.19

A small quality-of-life release: paste an Apple Music link and see exactly what MeedyaDL is about to download before it joins the queue.

### What's new

- **Preview what you're about to download.** Paste an Apple Music link into the Download page and a small card now shows what MeedyaDL will fetch — audio quality, lyrics formats, artwork, companion versions, and music videos — based on your current settings, before you add it to the queue. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/pull/917))

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
